# Pembagian Training dan Testing Data
```{r}
ts_sunspot<-ts_bulanan
n_total <- length(ts_sunspot)
n_test <- 240
n_train <- n_total - n_test

train_data <- window(ts_sunspot, end = time(ts_sunspot)[n_train])
test_data <- window(ts_sunspot, start = time(ts_sunspot)[n_train + 1])
```
```{r}
plot(train_data, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Bulan", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Training")
```
```{r}
plot(test_data, 
     type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1.5,
     xlab = "Bulan", ylab = "Rata-rata Sunspot", 
     main = "Data Testing")
```

# Seasonal 
## Lag 11
### Differencing
```{r}
D1 <- diff(d1, lag = 132) 
plot.ts(D1, lty=1, xlab="Waktu", ylab="Data Difference Seasonal 1 Sunspot", main="Plot Difference Seasonal")
```
Indikasi D=1, s=132.



### ACF setelah differencing musiman
```{r}
acf(D1, lag.max = 396, main = "ACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 132")
```
ACF cut off setelah lag musiman, indikasi Seasonal MA (Q=1). Indikasi q=2
### PACF setelah differencing
```{r}
pacf(D1, lag.max = 396, main = "PACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 132")
```
PACF tails off di lag musiman dan kelipatannya, indikasi Seasonal AR (P=0). Indikasi p=5.
###EACF
```{r}
eacf(D1)
```


## Lag 5
### Differencing
```{r}

```

### PACF setelah differencing

```{r}
pacf(D2, lag.max = 300, main = "PACF Setelah Differencing Musiman 60")
```

# Model Fourier
```{r}
buat_fourier <- function(waktu, periode = 132, K = 2) {
  hasil <- matrix(nrow = length(waktu), ncol = 2 * K)
  for (k in 1:K) {
    hasil[, 2*k-1] <- sin(2 * pi * k * waktu / periode)
    hasil[, 2*k]   <- cos(2 * pi * k * waktu / periode)
  }
  colnames(hasil) <- paste0(rep(c("sin", "cos"), K), rep(1:K, each = 2))
  return(hasil)
}

t_train <- 1:length(train_data)
t_test  <- (length(train_data) + 1):(length(train_data) + length(test_data))
```

```{r}
fourier_train_k1 <- buat_fourier(t_train, periode = 132, K = 1)
fourier_test_k1  <- buat_fourier(t_test,  periode = 132, K = 1)

model_fourier_k1 <- auto.arima(train_data, xreg = fourier_train_k1, seasonal = FALSE)
ramalan_fourier_k1 <- forecast::forecast(model_fourier_k1, h = length(test_data), xreg = fourier_test_k1)
summary(model_fourier_k1)
```

# Tabel Perbandingan Training
```{r}
get_ic <- function(model, name) {
  if (inherits(model, "tbats")) {
    n <- length(model$y)
    k <- length(coef(model))
    AIC_val <- model$AIC
    AICc_val <- AIC_val + (2 * k * (k + 1)) / (n - k - 1)
    logLik_val <- (2 * k - AIC_val) / 2
    BIC_val  <- -2 * logLik_val + k * log(n)
  } else {
    AIC_val  <- model$aic
    AICc_val <- model$aicc
    BIC_val  <- model$bic
  }
  data.frame(Model = name, AIC = AIC_val, AICc = AICc_val, BIC = BIC_val)
}

tabel_train_bulanan <- rbind(
  get_ic(model6,            "SARIMA (Model 6)"),
  get_ic(model_tbats,       "TBATS (12 & 132)"),
  get_ic(model_ets,         "ETS (Auto)"),
  get_ic(model_fourier_k1,  "Fourier K=1"),
  get_ic(model_fourier_k2,  "Fourier K=2")
)

tabel_train_bulanan <- tabel_train_bulanan[order(tabel_train_bulanan$AICc), ]
tabel_train_bulanan[, 2:4] <- round(tabel_train_bulanan[, 2:4], 2)
rownames(tabel_train_bulanan) <- NULL

print(tabel_train_bulanan)
```
# Tabel Perbandingan Testing
```{r}
aktual_test <- as.numeric(test_data)
naive_err_bulanan <- mean(abs(diff(as.numeric(train_data), lag = 132)))

hitung_metrik <- function(prediksi, aktual, denom_mase) {
  err <- aktual - prediksi
  rmse <- sqrt(mean(err^2))
  mae  <- mean(abs(err))
  mase <- mae / denom_mase
  return(c(RMSE = rmse, MAE = mae, MASE = mase))
}

pred_sarima <- as.numeric(prediksi_asli)
pred_tbats  <- as.numeric(ramalan_tbats$mean)
pred_sn     <- as.numeric(ramalan_snaive$mean)
pred_ets    <- as.numeric(ramalan_ets$mean)
pred_f1     <- as.numeric(ramalan_fourier_k1$mean)
pred_f2     <- as.numeric(ramalan_fourier_k2$mean)

m_sarima <- hitung_metrik(pred_sarima, aktual_test, naive_err_bulanan)
m_tbats  <- hitung_metrik(pred_tbats,  aktual_test, naive_err_bulanan)
m_sn     <- hitung_metrik(pred_sn,     aktual_test, naive_err_bulanan)
m_ets    <- hitung_metrik(pred_ets,    aktual_test, naive_err_bulanan)
m_f1     <- hitung_metrik(pred_f1,     aktual_test, naive_err_bulanan)
m_f2     <- hitung_metrik(pred_f2,     aktual_test, naive_err_bulanan)

tabel_test_bulanan <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Seasonal Naive", "SARIMA (Model 6)", "TBATS (12 & 132)", "ETS (Auto)", "Fourier K=1", "Fourier K=2"),
  RMSE  = round(c(m_sn["RMSE"], m_sarima["RMSE"], m_tbats["RMSE"], m_ets["RMSE"], m_f1["RMSE"], m_f2["RMSE"]), 2),
  MAE   = round(c(m_sn["MAE"],  m_sarima["MAE"],  m_tbats["MAE"],  m_ets["MAE"],  m_f1["MAE"],  m_f2["MAE"]), 2),
  MASE  = round(c(m_sn["MASE"], m_sarima["MASE"], m_tbats["MASE"], m_ets["MASE"], m_f1["MASE"], m_f2["MASE"]), 4)
)

tabel_test_bulanan <- tabel_test_bulanan[order(tabel_test_bulanan$MASE), ]
rownames(tabel_test_bulanan) <- NULL

print(tabel_test_bulanan)
```
# Tabel Perbandingan Diagnostik dan Signifikansi
```{r}
ekstrak_diagnostik_bulanan <- function(model, name) {
  if (inherits(model, "tbats")) {
    total_par <- length(model$lambda) + length(model$alpha) + length(model$beta) + 
                 length(model$damping.parameter) + length(model$gamma.one.values) + 
                 length(model$gamma.two.values) + length(model$ar.coefficients) + 
                 length(model$ma.coefficients) + 2 * sum(model$k.vector)
  } else {
    total_par <- length(coef(model))
  }
  
  sig_par <- NA 
  if (inherits(model, "Arima")) {
    p_vals <- lmtest::coeftest(model)[, 4]
    sig_par <- sum(p_vals < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  sisaan <- residuals(model)
  
  lb_p     <- Box.test(sisaan, lag = 24, type = "Ljung-Box")$p.value
  arch_p   <- Box.test((sisaan)^2, lag = 24, type = "Ljung-Box")$p.value
  shapiro_p <- tryCatch(shapiro.test(sisaan)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
  ttest_p   <- tryCatch(t.test(sisaan, mu = 0)$p.value, error = function(e) NA)
  
  data.frame(
    Model = name,
    Total_Par = total_par,
    Signifikan = sig_par,
    LB = lb_p,
    Shapiro = shapiro_p,
    ARCH = arch_p,
    T_Test = ttest_p
  )
}

tabel_diag_bulanan <- rbind(
  ekstrak_diagnostik_bulanan(model6,           "SARIMA (Model 6)"),
  ekstrak_diagnostik_bulanan(model_tbats,      "TBATS (12 & 132)"),
  ekstrak_diagnostik_bulanan(model_ets,        "ETS (Auto)"),
  ekstrak_diagnostik_bulanan(model_fourier_k1, "Fourier K=1"),
  ekstrak_diagnostik_bulanan(model_fourier_k2, "Fourier K=2")
)

cols_to_round <- c("LB", "Shapiro", "ARCH", "T_Test")
tabel_diag_bulanan[cols_to_round] <- round(tabel_diag_bulanan[cols_to_round], 3)

print(tabel_diag_bulanan)
```
